title: S3-lane pure guard model — network I/O qualification boundary (what the model does NOT qualify)

authority.reviewAnchor: #5945831322 P2-2 (S3 DNS/byte transport are injected seams and do not prove real Host TLS/timeout/body invariants)
authority.qualificationConsequence: G4_QUALIFICATION stays NOT_ADMITTED; no real-Host DNS, TLS, timeout or body invariant is qualified by the pure model or by this boundary evidence

modelUnderBoundary.usedByThisLane: imported read-only; this lane adds NO model change

aspects.detail: mediaUrl() enforces strict https syntax, hostname shape, media path pattern and URL canonicalization before any admission; SOURCE_REJECTED on violation.
aspects.existingWitness: W-S3-P*/W-S3-C* (#166 REFINEMENT.json) — unit coverage lives there; this lane does not re-run it

aspects.aspect: redirect admission, echo check, visited-cycle detection, redirect bound
aspects.detail: The read loop owns redirect policy: initial-vs-redirect admission callbacks, admission echo (admission.uri must equal the exact URL), visited list cycle detection and the maxRedirects bound.

validateReaderBounds fail-closes construction on non-integer or out-of-range maxBytes/timeoutMs/maxRedirects. Validation is a CONFIG gate only; runtime ENFORCEMENT of the byte/timeout budgets is delegated (QB-06/QB-07).

aspects.aspect: real DNS resolution and public-IP classification
aspects.detail: The reader consumes whatever pinnedIp the injected resolvePublic seam returns and forwards it to hop without reclassification. A seam returning a reserved/private address is accepted — public classification is a SEAM obligation (the original resolvePublic/classifyDnsAnswers discipline), not a loop invariant.
aspects.notQualified: real DNS A-answer acquisition, resolver deadlines, reserved-range classification of the actually-connected address

aspects.aspect: real TLS handshake, certificate authorization and peer identity
aspects.detail: tlsPeerOkay() is exported as the per-hop peer-identity SPEC (encrypted + authorized + exact remoteAddress equality), but the model's read loop never opens a socket, never sees a socket, and never invokes tlsPeerOkay — the connected-socket facts are produced entirely outside the model by the hop seam / Host transport.
aspects.notQualified: certificate chain validity, hostname authorization, protocol negotiation, revocation, TOFU behavior of any real stack

aspects.aspect: byte transport and body size/content bounds
aspects.detail: maxBytes is handed to the hop seam; the loop returns the seam's body reply verbatim (bytes identity preserved) without measuring length or content type. An oversized body from a compliant-shaped hop reply is accepted — bounds ENFORCEMENT is the transport's obligation (QB-03 only validates the configuration).
aspects.notQualified: real byte streaming, content-length truthfulness, media-type verification, truncation behavior

aspects.detail: The loop computes one deadline (performance.now() + timeoutMs) and passes it to the seams; it imposes no interrupt of its own. A seam that ignores the deadline still completes. Actual timeout enforcement is Host/transport behavior.
aspects.notQualified: real wall-clock aborts, partial-body timeout semantics, clock behavior under load

aspects.aspect: network-free structural property (no real I/O path exists in the pure model)
aspects.detail: Structural, machine-checked: the model imports only node:dns/promises + node:perf_hooks; resolve4 is referenced only inside resolvePublicViaDns (shipped for parity with the original source, never invoked by any test path); the reader factory hard-fails construction unless BOTH seams are injected functions, so no default network path can be constructed.

aspects.aspect: seam failure mapping (DNS_REJECTED / hop failure passthrough)
aspects.detail: What the model DOES add around the seams: an undefined seam answer maps to DNS_REJECTED; a hop {kind:'failure'} reply maps to failure(reason) verbatim; reply shapes other than body/failure/redirect are unreachable by construction. The mapping is model logic; the underlying failure causes are seam behavior.

summary.notQualifiedConsequence: any claim of real-Host DNS/TLS/timeout/body qualification requires a separately authorized trusted Host lane; this boundary evidence grants none
